content_sections.heading: About IIT Mandi Associate Professor
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Mandi, located in Himachal Pradesh, invites online applications from candidates with an outstanding track record for faculty positions. These positions are specifically for the Indian Knowledge System and Mental Health Applications (IKSMHA) Centre in designated areas of specialization.

rows.department_centre: Indian Knowledge System and Mental Health Applications (IKSMHA) Centre
rows.areas_of_specialization: Contemplative Psychology, First-person Research Methods, Consciousness Studies

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The candidate should have demonstrated adequate experience of independent research in terms of guidance of M.Tech. and Ph.D. students, strong record of publications in journals of high impact factor, patents, laboratory/course development and/or other recognized relevant professional activities.

rows.qualification: Ph.D. in appropriate branch / discipline and first class in the preceding degree with very good academic record throughout.
rows.experience: A minimum of 06 years of post Ph.D. experience in teaching/ research/ professional experience of which at least three years should be at the level of Assistant Professor in an academic institution or Senior Scientific Officer/Senior Design Engineer or equivalent position in a research organization or industry as on the date of application.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the Associate Professor position will receive a pay structure under Level: 13A2, Cell-01 with a starting basic pay of ₹ 1,39,600/- per month as per the 7th CPC. Applicants called for an interview will be reimbursed for to and fro travel expenses within India, provided Economy Class Air Fare Tickets are purchased exclusively through authorized travel agents: Indian Railways Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd. (IRCTC), M/s Balmer Lawrie & Company Limited (BLCL), or M/s Ashoka Tours & Travels (ATT). Accommodation may be provided on a payment basis in the Institute Guest House subject to availability.

content_sections.heading: IIT Mandi Associate Professor Important Dates
How to Apply for IIT Mandi Associate Professor
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at https://fap.iitmandi.ac.in/. Complete the online registration and fill out the application form with all required details. Ensure that all relevant information and supporting documents are uploaded properly before finalizing the application. Submit the online application form on or before 06.11.2026. Keep a copy of the application for his/her record. No hard copy of the application need to be submitted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must ensure that all the relevant information and documents have been uploaded before finalizing the application. Applicants employed in Government and Semi Government organizations, Public Undertakings, University and Educational Institutions should submit their application through proper channel or submit “No Objection Certificate” from the current employer at the time of Interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for the post of Associate Professor at the IKSMHA Centre.

faq.question: Q2. What are the areas of specialization required for the post?
faq.answer: The required areas of specialization are Contemplative Psychology, First-person Research Methods, and Consciousness Studies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay scale for IIT Mandi Associate Professor?
faq.answer: The selected candidates are placed in Level: 13A2, Cell-01 with a starting basic pay of ₹ 1,39,600/- as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q4. When does the online application window close?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 06.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in the appropriate branch or discipline along with a first class in the preceding degree and a very good academic record throughout.

faq.question: Q6. How many years of experience are required to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants require a minimum of 06 years of post-Ph.D. experience in teaching, research, or professional fields, including at least three years at the level of Assistant Professor or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Is it necessary to submit a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: No, candidates are not required to submit a hard copy of the application to the institute.
